events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app; grep -n -E 'script\.google|\.route\(' scripts/probe-workshop.mjs | cut -c1-170 | head -12; grep -n -E '"(dev|start|build)[^"]*"' package.json | cut -c1-160; grep -c . .env.local 2>/dev/null | head -1; grep -o -E '^NEXT_PUBLIC_[A-Z_]*(WEBHOOK|FORM)[A-Z_]*' .env.local 2>/dev/null

events.name: Bash
events.head: Start a local dev server and run the Pro probe against the live mirror
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app; (PORT=4430 nohup npx next dev -p 4430 >/tmp/t087-dev.log 2>&1 &); BASE=https://adisuja.github.io PREFIX=/tantra-workshop-live/site node scripts/probe-pro.mjs >/tmp/t087-probe-pro.log 2>&1; echo "exit $?"; grep -c '^PASS' /tmp/t087-probe-pro.log; grep -E '^FAIL|n8n|checkout start' /tmp/t087-probe-pro.log | cut -c1-200; tail -2 /tmp/t087-probe-pro.log | cut -c1-200; tail -3 /tmp/t087-dev.log

events.name: Bash
events.head: Run the workshop probe against the local dev server
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app; tail -4 /tmp/t087-dev.log | cut -c1-160; curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' --max-time 90 http://localhost:4430/workshop; node scripts/probe-workshop.mjs >/tmp/t087-probe-ws.log 2>&1; echo "exit $?"; grep -ciE '^\s*(ok|pass|✓)' /tmp/t087-probe-ws.log; grep -iE 'defect|fail|✗' /tmp/t087-probe-ws.log | cut -c1-240 | head -15; tail -3 /tmp/t087-probe-ws.log | cut -c1-240

events.name: Bash
events.head: Group the workshop probe failures by cause
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app; grep -E '^\s+[a-z]+:' /tmp/t087-probe-ws.log | sed -E 's/[0-9]+px//' | cut -c1-150 | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head -8; grep -E 'FAIL' /tmp/t087-probe-ws.log | awk '{print $2}' | sort | uniq -c; sed -n 190,206p scripts/probe-workshop.mjs | cut -c1-210; sed -n 1,39p scripts/probe-workshop.mjs | grep -n -iE 'node scripts|BASE=|run' | cut -c1-200

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check the calendar service CORS and run the workshop probe against the live mirror
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app; grep -c 'stubApi(' scripts/probe-workshop.mjs; grep -n 'newPage()' scripts/probe-workshop.mjs | wc -l; for o in http://localhost:4430 http://localhost:4322 http://localhost:3000; do echo "$o -> $(curl -s -o /dev/null -D - --max-time 5 -X OPTIONS -H "Origin: $o" -H 'Access-Control-Request-Method: POST' http://127.0.0.1:8790/cal/issue | grep -i 'access-control-allow-origin' | tr -d '\r')"; done; BASE=https://adisuja.github.io PREFIX=/tantra-workshop-live/site node scripts/probe-workshop.mjs >/tmp/t087-probe-ws-live.log 2>&1; echo "exit $?"; grep -E

events.name: Bash
events.head: See if port 4322 is in use and read the mirror failure reasons
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app; lsof -iTCP:4322 -sTCP:LISTEN -P -n 2>/dev/null | tail -1 | cut -c1-80; grep -B1 -A3 'FAIL' /tmp/t087-probe-ws-live.log | grep -vE '^\s*ok' | cut -c1-230 | head -16

events.name: Bash
events.head: Restart the dev server on 4322 and rerun the workshop probe
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app; kill $(lsof -tiTCP:4430 -sTCP:LISTEN) 2>/dev/null; sleep 2; (nohup npx next dev -p 4322 >/tmp/t087-dev.log 2>&1 &); for i in $(seq 1 30); do c=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' --max-time 60 http://localhost:4322/workshop); [ "$c" = 200 ] && break; sleep 2; done; echo "up $c"; BASE=http://localhost:4322 node scripts/probe-workshop.mjs >/tmp/t087-probe-ws.log 2>&1; echo "exit $?"; grep -cE '^\s*ok ' /tmp/t087-probe-ws.log; grep -B2 'FAIL' /tmp/t087-probe-ws.log | cut -c1-240 | head -24; tail -2 /tmp/t087-probe-ws.log | cut -c1-200
